title: へ (direction)
meaning: "to / toward" — direction of movement. Pronounced え.
simpleExplanation: へ means "to / toward" and marks the direction you move in. It is written with the kana へ but pronounced え. With the movement verbs 行く (go), 来る (come) and 帰る (return) you can use either へ or に; へ feels a little more like "heading toward", に more like "arriving at". For a beginner they are interchangeable in these sentences.
whenUsed: Before verbs of movement: 行きます, 来ます, 帰ります, 歩きます, 出かけます. Common in questions like どこへ行きますか "Where are you going?" and in the fixed phrase 〜への (a letter TO Japan).
formation: Place + へ + 行きます／来ます／帰ります
Place + へ + の + noun  (日本への手紙)

examples.reading: にほんへ いきます。
えきへ あるきます。

examples.ja: 何時に家へ帰りますか。
examples.reading: なんじに いえへ かえりますか。
examples.en: What time do you go home?
examples.note: Going back home: 家へ帰る. 家に帰る is equally correct.

examples.ja: 夏休みに国へ帰ります。
examples.reading: なつやすみに くにへ かえります。
examples.en: I'm going back to my country in the summer holidays.
examples.note: 帰る (return) works with へ or に.

examples.ja: これは母への手紙です。
examples.reading: これは ははへの てがみです。
examples.en: This is a letter to my mother.
examples.note: Only へ can be followed by の to describe a noun; ×母にの手紙.

similarGrammar.difference: に is the arrival point and has many other uses (time, existence, recipient). へ is only direction.
で marks where an action happens, never where you go to.
を marks the place you leave or pass through (家を出る); へ marks where you head to.

commonMistakes.why: The particle is spelled へ even though it sounds like え.
で marks the place of an action or a means of transport (バスで). The destination takes へ or に.

commonMistakes.wrong: 友達へ本をあげます。(fine in speech, but)
commonMistakes.why: For the receiver of a thing, に is the standard particle. へ is for physical direction of movement.

usageNotes: With 行く・来る・帰る, に and へ are interchangeable. へ stresses direction, に stresses arrival point. Only へ can be followed by の (日本への手紙 "a letter to Japan").
jlptTips: If the verb is 行きます・来ます・帰ります and both へ and に are options, the exam will not make you choose between them; the other options will be wrong ones like で or を. Pick the direction particle that is offered.
Only へ can precede の (日本への旅行). If the blank is followed by の + noun, the answer is へ.
